verdict.rationale: Superpowers has no export feature, but its artifacts are already in open, portable forms. Skills are plain SKILL.md files shared verbatim across harnesses, and plans and specs are Markdown docs. The SDD workspace is deleted once review is clean, leaving git history as the durable record. It runs on many harnesses and never edits the user's files, so leaving looks easy, though this is implied rather than stated. Missing for 10: any explicit documentation of data export or exit, an inventory of what user data or state the plugin keeps, and independent corroboration of portability.
